dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ploy, you think rich families should pay. Can you explain why?
dialogue.reading: ˈplɔɪ, juː ˈθɪŋk ˈrɪtʃ ˈfæməliz ʃʊd ˈpeɪ. kən juː ɪkˈspleɪn ˈwaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Free university costs a lot of money. The government has to pay for it, and that means everyone pays.
dialogue.reading: ˈfriː ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈkɔːsts ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈmʌni. ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ˈhæs tə ˈpeɪ fər ɪt, ənd ðæt ˈmiːnz ˈɛvriwʌn ˈpeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I see your point, but good universities help everyone in the country.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː jʊr ˈpɔɪnt, bʌt ˈɡʊd ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ˈhɛlp ˈɛvriwʌn ɪn ðə ˈkʌntri.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm not sure I agree. Many graduates move abroad and never come back.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr aɪ əˈɡriː. ˈmɛni ˈɡrædʒuəts ˈmuːv əˈbrɔːd ənd ˈnɛvər ˈkʌm ˈbæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's partly true. But most of them stay and work here.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈpɑːrtli ˈtruː. bʌt ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈsteɪ ənd ˈwɜːrk ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about poor students? Should they pay anything?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈpʊr ˈstuːdənts? ʃʊd ðeɪ ˈpeɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Absolutely not. Poor students should never have to pay.
dialogue.reading: ˌæbsəˈluːtli ˈnɑːt. ˈpʊr ˈstuːdənts ʃʊd ˈnɛvər ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Exactly! Money shouldn't stop anyone from studying.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli! ˈmʌni ˈʃʊdənt ˈstɑːp ˈɛniwʌn frəm ˈstʌdiɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I couldn't agree more. So we agree on one thing!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkʊdənt əˈɡriː ˈmɔːr. soʊ wiː əˈɡriː ɑːn ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. A debate doesn't mean you disagree about everything.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ə dɪˈbeɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈmiːn juː ˌdɪsəˈɡriː əˈbaʊt ˈɛvriθɪŋ.
